meta.promptText: I want to buy running shoes under ₹3000 in India. Which ones should I get?

response.text:
If I were buying running shoes in India with a budget of ₹3,000, I’d prioritize **cushioning, a comfortable fit, and grip on roads** over brand name alone.

My first choice would be a Decathlon running shoe for regular jogging, or an ASICS or Nike model if you find a genuine pair on sale within budget. Here are the strongest options I found in current shopping results.

search_results.title: Prime Big Deal Days Are Packed With Marathon Gear Sales. These 10 Picks Are Worth Your Money
search_results.description: Today marks the final day of Amazon's Prime Big Deal Days, offering substantial discounts on a wide range of marathon gear. Featured items include Nike Revolution 8 running shoes, praised for their lightweight design and performance, now available at nearly 30% off. Shokz OpenRun Pro 2 headphones, known for their bone-conduction tech and long battery life, are also 30% off. Additional deals include the Nathan Hydration Belt, Saucony RunDry Performance Socks in bulk, and Goodr sunglasses—commended for their affordability and fit—at 20% off. Seasonal running shorts from Baleaf and SloothFeel, the multi-purpose Aquaphor healing balm, Tailwind Nutrition Endurance Fuel, and Oars + Alps sunscreen are all discounted as well. Carefully curated by editors and testers, these deals cater to runners preparing for races, providing expert-recommended, high-performance gear at reduced prices.

search_results.title: These New Balance Running Shoes Beat 75 Sneakers in Our Tests-Now They're 41% Off for Prime Day
search_results.description: During Amazon's October Prime Day (October 6-7), shoppers can find significant discounts on New Balance sneakers, with some pairs priced up to 41% off. This includes the top-rated running shoes worn by a Good Housekeeping editor during a marathon. The article highlights that New Balance offers a wide range of high-performing footwear, including running shoes, cross trainers, casual footwear, and walking shoes. According to tests performed by the Good Housekeeping Institute Textiles Lab, New Balance shoes stood out among over 75 sneaker options tested, including their top pick for the best running shoes, which is currently on sale. The deals provide a limited-time opportunity for consumers to purchase editor-recommended, high-quality athletic footwear at discounted prices.
